description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application. It imports necessary React modules, CSS files, and the main App component. It initializes the root DOM node and renders the App component within React's StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree into a DOM node.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM node managed by the root.
